final.role: File watching service that records file changes and triggers actions on matching changes.
final.evidence: Watchman exists to watch files and record when they actually change. It can also trigger actions. We support Windows and macOS builds; MIT License; maintained by Meta's source control team.

auditoria.nota: Vigia de arquivos com suporte oficial a Windows; candidato para detectar mudanças nas notas e disparar reindexação.
